acceptance_predicates.description: Every catalog-supported provider/model tuple is evaluated for opencode and opendesk with typed unsupported reasons.
Shared defaults and per-agent overrides persist across restart and feed benchmark and comparison routes.
The same selected tuples can be replayed offline with no provider network access.

definition_of_done: Independent exact-head review and hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: Catalog-supported agent, provider, model, defaults, and override selections.

outputs.description: Typed supported/unsupported matrix with persisted defaults and offline parity result.

gates.description: Positive, negative, persistence, and network-denied offline matrix checks pass; mechanical evidence must include offline parity.
